scope: Index of O1-O5 source locators reported in the manuscript, not a new independent source audit or execution record.

original_experiment_status: Planned twelve-trajectory pilot; not started; no experimental results. Historical 27 October statement.
experiment_status: Prospective five-arm, three-model v5 candidate, 33 trajectories per arm/model under a stated variance assumption; no collection, new freeze or prospective OSF amendment completed.

revision_evidence.scope: Three static source snapshots, targeted committed research/plan tracing and named GitHub metadata; not new historical deployment execution or independent human corroboration.
revision_evidence.historical_cloud_export_status: Owner explicitly deferred; repository evidence only.

author_review_context.scope: Process clarification from the participant, targeted local log/history checks and fetched PR bodies; supplements the historical observations without supplying new deployed-journey acceptance.

discovery_and_handoffs.finding: Discovery included repeated challenge and owner-directed revision. Requirements reconciliation continued after backlog generation. Role-agent answers remain exercise hypotheses.
Critiques of disposable prototype PRs 19, 24 and 27 informed simplicity requirements; direct staff usability research remained absent.
The desk-research journey atlas informed revised BRD/PRD requirements and ADR 0003, with unresolved quality and approval gates.
Later source history formalised recurring stabilization and a qualified local checkpoint. This is outside the original case window and does not establish a date of restored deployed usability.

project_insights_export.provenance: Owner-supplied chart.csv text associated with GitHub project 7; all supplied rows and column names preserved with LF line endings. The checksum binds this repository copy, not unavailable original-download bytes.
project_insights_export.year: 2026 inferred from the owner discussion; absent from CSV labels
project_insights_export.interpretation: Supports a batch backlog expansion and later issue-state movement. It does not identify PR throughput, accepted features, issue-reopening history or deployed usability.
project_insights_export.insights_page_retrieval: HTTP 404; the supplied export is the available chart evidence.

observations.reported_observation: An MVP with sign-in and realistic synthetic data was used during 8-14 October; the replacement was reported on 16 October as having one case, no staff and no model.
observations.evidence_state: Partial: reported log provenance plus author account; no new execution corroboration.
observations.interpretation: A usability discontinuity motivates checking migration, configuration and retained behaviour separately.
required_corroboration: Recover dated before/after journey records and deployment revisions.
Execute the same journey against identified configurations before calling the observation a code regression.

observations.reported_observation: 183 pull requests were merged during 15-24 October; the scorer recorded 5/5 completeness; the author could not sign in to the replacement.
observations.evidence_state: Partial: chronology and author report; release/scope correspondence and retained source captures remain unverified.
observations.interpretation: Completion and usability differed in the chronology; this is not yet a verified same-release contradiction.
required_corroboration: Retain the dated API and score captures.
Link assessed commit, capability scope, deployment/configuration and failed journey before testing score/behaviour agreement.

observations.reported_observation: Requirements and log records grew; PR445 is reported as a two-line change accompanied by a 78-line evidence record.
observations.evidence_state: Reported repository/version locators; the index adds no new review-effort measurement.
observations.interpretation: Artefact volume motivates examining burden; it is not itself a measure of decay or wasted effort.
required_corroboration: Recover exact PR/diff and evidence-record locators.
Measure effort, avoided defects and accepted behaviour before assigning a net process cost.

observations.reported_observation: Log tracing found the last simplicity citation on 13 October; the replacement lacked registration/staff bindings.
observations.evidence_state: Reported log tracing and deployment account; actual session context and fault transmission are unverified.
observations.interpretation: The effective read path is a candidate explanation, not a demonstrated loss of agent knowledge.
required_corroboration: Recover the actual later session inputs and configuration evidence.
Check whether the lesson was available, understood and executable rather than inferring absence of knowledge from a missing citation.

observations.reported_observation: Coordinator instructions and ADR0006 describe RPI records, full gates, delegated merging and migration priority; the author continued resolving blockers.
observations.evidence_state: Reported instruction/decision locators plus author account; product-use cadence was not independently instrumented.
observations.interpretation: Substantial oversight can coexist with weak outcome-level feedback; the case does not isolate an autonomy effect.
required_corroboration: Recover session and approval/product-use events where retained.
Keep migration, workload, model and deployment rivals distinct from the separate consolidation pilot.
